items.title: XLM parity and threat model
items.blockedReason: XRC source supports XLM/USD and defaults to a received-rate floor of 3 and freshness up to 120 seconds, but live XLM quote/quorum is unknown. The read-only connector refused the backend for lack of a service-discoverability manifest; the direct XRC sample is a paid update and was not called.
items.nextAction: Verify connected-wallet CreateAccount and native Payment first-funding support; establish an authorized read-only path for XRC XLM/USD and independently validate provider endpoints when DNS access is available.

items.title: Verified deposits and borrowing
items.blockedReason: The new pure deposit_evidence decision helper is not wired into open/confirm endpoints, provider-account quorum, or atomic mutation; no live credit lifecycle exists. Tests and compilation are pending.
items.nextAction: Compile/test the pending-row and reserve/receipt decisions, then implement public open/confirm, key derivation, provider binding, and atomic deposit credit/receipt/tombstone lifecycle; preserve WP3 blocked until end-to-end evidence exists.

items.title: Claims, exits, and liquidation handling
items.blockedReason: No supported XLM claim, withdrawal, close, or liquidation payout lifecycle exists. Unsupported routes fail closed in source, but the current guards have not been Cargo-tested; claim/intent state is dormant and Frozen config keeps XLM unreachable.
items.nextAction: Compile/test the claim recorder's fee, destination, and key/network guards when the shared heavy slot is available; then integrate and validate XLM claim settlement/reconciliation, keeping WP4 blocked until payout lifecycle evidence exists.

items.title: User flows, Candid, and monitoring
items.nextAction: Regenerate and verify Candid/frontend declarations after the developer-gated XLM key setter/getter change, then implement supported flows with explicit pending/unresolved states; keep them unavailable until route and integration safety is resolved.

items.title: Tests, independent review, and testnet
items.nextAction: Run focused Cargo validation after 8dd604c7 when the shared slot is available; verify fixed-slot classification/wrapper plus reserve quorum and freshness, resolve provider independence, then complete endpoint wiring, settlement, testnet, frontend, oracle, and release work. Keep the XRP post-sign race separate, not an XLM gate.

items.nextAction: Complete key/network/provider binding, current reserve/oracle checks, claim settlement, testnet, frontend, and release prerequisites while registration remains frozen.
